summary_1line: Bhishma explains the rituals, merits, and cautions of gifting cows, praising righteous donors and warning against giving unworthy animals.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma lying on his bed of arrows instructs Yudhishthira about the sacred merits of gifting cows.
A richly adorned cow with a calf, wrapped in cloth, is ceremonially presented to a Brahmana by a king.
King Yudhishthira humbly living on barley and cow products while sleeping on bare earth in devotion to cow worship.
